atoms.b: The past perfect tense shows that something took place ((++prior_to after)) another action in the past.
To form the past perfect, you need the helping verb ((++had was)) and the past participle form of a verb.

instruction.text: Select the past perfect form in the sentence.

atoms.sound: After I had done my homework, I played a video game.
atoms.b: After I ((had done)) my homework, I played a video game.

instruction.text: Select the past perfect form in the sentence.

atoms.sound: He learnt to sew because he had ripped a button off his shirt.
atoms.b: He learnt to sew because he ((had ripped)) a button off his shirt.

instruction.text: Select the past perfect form in the sentence.

atoms.sound: I had finished cooking dinner by the time my parents came home
atoms.b: I ((had finished)) cooking dinner by the time my parents came home.

instruction.text: Match the verbs with their past participle forms.
Fill in the blanks with the past perfect form of the verb.

hint.text:
Remember: to form the past perfect tense, you need the helping verb had + the past participle form of a verb.

For example:
She had done this before.
hint.sound: Remember: to form the past perfect tense, you need the helping verb, had, and the past participle form of a verb. For example: She had done this before.

atoms.b: She ((had_shown)) her friend how to play the game before they started playing.
I ((had)) never ((sat)) in the front row before.
Her grandpa ((had_built)) the house for her grandma.
They ((had_caught)) a cold on their journey.
